title: Lamb Tagine
description: A rich and aromatic Indian-inspired stew made with tender lamb, lovely spices, and a hint of charred flavor. Serve over basmati rice for a truly authentic experience.

ingredients.name: lovely spices
ingredients.amount: 2 tablespoons garam masala, 1 tablespoon cumin powder, 1 tablespoon coriander powder

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat.
Add lamb and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add onion, ginger, and garlic. Cook until onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add garam masala, cumin powder, coriander powder, smoked paprika, and tagine spice blend. Cook for 1 minute.
Add diced tomatoes, coconut milk, and chicken broth. Bring to a boil.
Reduce heat to low, cover, and simmer for 1 1/2 hours, or until lamb is tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve over basmati rice and garnish with fresh cilantro, if desired.
